title: Sat nav usability and missing features
summary: Feedback on the sat nav centers on weak usability and missing or unreliable functions, with one clear positive example and several comments that are too brief or context-light to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the sat nav responds quickly and helps with navigating unfamiliar routes.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes the sat nav as poor or not fit for purpose, citing inferior performance without an upgrade, lack of voice-command support, vanished voice function, missing sat nav features, and phone connection problems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention the sat nav or related screen and app setup but are too brief or context-limited to classify confidently from the fragment alone.

limitations: Several fragments are very short or lack enough context to distinguish clearly between praise, criticism, and broader infotainment comments.
One negative example combines sat nav issues with phone connectivity, so not every complaint is specific to navigation alone.
